screens.title: Settings › Drop Noise with rules
screens.shows: Badges with Message Edits off, OTP card, Excluded Contacts, Blocked Words & Phrases (added)
text: Rules for messages that should not be forwarded
Messages with a verification code, such as "Your OTP is 482913", are never sent.
Messages from these people are never sent, not even from a synced group.
Messages that contain any of these are never sent. Upper and lower case are treated the same.
Changes apply to messages received from now on. Messages already sent are not changed.
